This is a remote role for candidates located in Montevideo, Uruguay.
About LawnStarter
LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $100M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services — operating across three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome) on a single shared platform.
About Engineering at LawnStarter
We build in small, focused initiative teams: a Product Engineer working alongside a PM and a designer, supported by an Engineering Manager who helps you grow. You'll also work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering peers across initiatives in a shared codebase. The whole team owns whether the work moves its metric.
AI coding agents are a force multiplier here — they give a small, senior team the leverage to ship more, faster, and at a higher bar for quality. We hire engineers who are wired for ownership and energized by shipping to a real marketplace with customers and pros on both sides.

You're the engineering anchor of an initiative — working as part of a tight team with your PM and designer, and alongside engineering peers on adjacent initiatives. You have a hand in the full lifecycle: shaping the problem, deciding the technical approach, directing AI agents to implement much of the code, shipping to production, and — with your team — owning the outcome.
You're measured by impact, not by lines of code merged. When an agent can ship something safely, your job is to make sure it's done right and the metric moves. When the work calls for careful, hand-written code in a sensitive area, you write it yourself.

You ship end-to-end. From problem-framing through production to the post-launch metric review — you see the whole arc and own the result with your team.
You work as a true product partner. You sit at the table with PM and design, bringing engineering judgment to product calls and product sense to engineering calls.
You get real autonomy — with the right checkpoints. You make most technical calls yourself, with architect review on significant architectural decisions and fast input from peers.
You operate at a staff bar. You're trusted to make the call, ship the hard thing, and stand behind the outcome.
What You'll Own
The technical approach — architecture, data model, integration choices, rollout plan, observability, and rollback strategy for your initiative. You make most calls yourself and bring significant architectural decisions to architect review; you document them, and revisit if the data says you were wrong.
Implementation quality — the prompts, guardrails, evals, tests, and review loop that let agents ship safe, correct, production-ready code. Most lines will be agent-authored, and you're accountable for them — held to the same standard as the rest of the team working in a shared codebase.
Cross-functional partnership — daily working contact with your PM (scope, tradeoffs) and designer (UX decisions, in-tool prototyping), regular collaboration with engineering peers, and weekly check-ins with your EM.
The initiative outcome — the metric the initiative was set up to move. With your PM, you present results 2–4 weeks post-launch and share the "did it work" answer.
A high bar for what ships — production correctness, security, performance, observability, and the experience for customers and pros. Agents accelerate you; they don't lower the bar.
Problems to Solve
Leading AI agents at a staff-level quality bar Most of the code on your initiative will be authored by AI agents. The craft is making them ship as if a senior engineer wrote it: prompts that encode our conventions, evals that catch issues before merge, tests that exercise the edges, observability that catches a regression before a customer does. How do you build a workflow that lets a small team ship far more than its size would suggest?
Owning decisions with high autonomy You have real latitude to make and document technical calls quickly — with architect review on the big architectural ones and peers to pressure-test your thinking. How do you move fast, keep your team aligned, and stay accountable to the outcome?
Shipping outcomes, not features Each initiative is measured by a metric — a conversion rate, a retention curve, a pro-funnel KPI, a unit-economics shift. You're accountable for the number alongside your team. How do you scope to actually move it, decide what *not* to build, and have the discipline to follow up 2–4 weeks after launch?
What Success Looks Like (Year 1)
Initiative outcomes hit — You've shipped 3–4 initiatives end-to-end, and at least two clearly moved their metric (with the post-launch review to prove it).
Agent workflow that travels — The prompts, evals, and review loop you built are picked up by peers on other initiatives.
Faster cycle time — Median time from problem-framing to first production rollout on your initiatives is meaningfully shorter.
Quality holds — No customer- or pro-facing regression traceable to agent-authored code that slipped through your review.
Visible leverage — Peers point to artifacts you left behind — runbooks, evals, agent workflows, post-launch write-ups — as references they use.

AI-native. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent are how you ship today — daily, on production work. You have real opinions about prompts, evals, agent loops, and review workflows, and you know when to let the agent run versus write it yourself.
Operating at a lead level. Whatever your current title, you've been the person making the call, shipping the hard thing, and standing behind whether it worked.
Outcome-driven. You measure your week in "did the metric move" and "did the experience get better." You read the post-launch dashboard and own the answer.
A strong horizontal partner. You hold your own with a strong PM and designer, and you collaborate well with engineering peers in a shared codebase. You bring engineering judgment to product calls and product judgment to engineering calls.
Decisive and documented. You make architecture, data-model, and rollout calls, write them down, get fast input, and move.
A force multiplier. Your impact compounds beyond your own initiative because you leave reusable artifacts behind — agent workflows, evals, runbooks, post-launch reviews.
Customer- and pro-minded. This is a real marketplace with real people on both sides, and you care about the outcomes for both.
Good to Know
An individual-contributor role with room to grow. People management sits with the EM — but the path into management is an open door for those who want it.
A product-engineering role, end-to-end. You ship features that move metrics; platform and architecture work happen inside the initiative when the outcome needs them.
Hands-on, with a high quality bar. Agents handle much of the implementation; you bring the judgment, design, safety, and accountability. The bar is high.
Shipping to a live marketplace. With $100M+ in bookings, customers and pros use what you ship within the same week.

Das sind wir.
Fitness-Tracker zeigen uns buchstäblich auf Schritt und Tritt, wie es um unsere Bewegungsbilanz steht. Mit Cheftresor haben wir eine Plattform geschaffen, die genau das für die Kennzahlen von Unternehmen leistet. Sie ermöglicht Steuerberatern, vorausschauend zu agieren, und Unternehmen, ihre Daten effektiv und gewinnbringend zu nutzen.
Bei Cheftresor dreht sich alles um Innovation und Fortschritt. Unsere Mission: Unternehmen und Steuerberater mit smarten Softwarelösungen zu stärken und ihre Zusammenarbeit grundlegend zu transformieren. Als junges Unternehmen, das gleichzeitig auf über 30 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Buchhaltung und Controlling zurückgreift, entwickeln wir Tools, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.
Doch Innovation allein ist nicht alles – wir setzen genauso auf ein wertschätzendes und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich jeder individuell entfalten kann. Bei uns steht Teamwork an erster Stelle: keine Ellenbogenmentalität, sondern ein agiles Miteinander, das Veränderung bewirkt und Türen öffnet.
Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!
Aufgaben
Das erwartet dich.
Du wirst Teil eines bunten Teams, das unsere erfolgreiche Software technologisch auf das nächste Level bringt. Deine Aufgaben sind abwechslungsreich, praxisnah und mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum sowie Eigenverantwortung verbunden. Konkret heißt das:
Du konzipierst und entwickelst neue Features und Anwendungen für unsere Controlling-Plattformen – von der technischen Spezifikation bis zum Rollout, eigenständig und im Team.
Du übernimmst technische Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung bestehender Module mit Blick auf Performance und Skalierbarkeit.
Du designst und implementierst stabile Schnittstellen zu internen und externen Systemen und sorgst für saubere Datenflüsse zwischen den Plattformen.
Du etablierst und verbesserst Qualitätsstandards, führst Tests durch und sicherst die Stabilität unserer Anwendungen.
Du bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen ein und entwickelst unsere Plattform technisch weiter.
Du identifizierst sinnvolle Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI in Controlling-Prozessen und arbeitest an der Integration KI-gestützter Funktionen, zum Beispiel für Analysen, Prognosen oder Assistenzfunktionen.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit.
Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht nur coden, sondern auch mitdenken möchte. Du solltest sehr eigenverantwortlich arbeiten können und Spaß daran haben, Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Kunden wirklich weiterbringen. Darüber hinaus findest du dich in folgenden Punkten wieder:
Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, Softwareentwicklung oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung moderner Webanwendungen mit und hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Frontend- und Backend-Technologien sowie im Umgang mit Datenbanken.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Themen und kannst komplexe Anforderungen in saubere Lösungen übersetzen.
Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, packst gerne an und gehst Herausforderungen mit Eigeninitiative und einer klaren Hands-on-Mentalität an.
Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit modernen Entwicklungsumgebungen, Cloud-Infrastrukturen oder automatisierten Deployments.
Du hast Interesse an KI-gestützten Anwendungen und idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit der Integration von KI oder Machine-Learning-Funktionen in Softwareprodukte.

Das bieten wir dir.
Unser Team ist unser größtes Kapital, und das soll auch so bleiben. Deshalb sorgen wir dafür, dass du dich bei uns wohlfühlst und weiterentwickeln kannst. Bei uns erwarten dich:
Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine zielführende Work-Life-Balance.
Attraktives Gehalt zwischen 75.000 € und 95.000 € – je nach Berufserfahrung und Tätigkeitsbereich.
Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven mit spannenden Entwicklungs- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Sachbezüge, Zuschüsse und betriebliche Kranken- und Rentenversicherung.
Teamevents und regelmäßige Traditionen wie unser Freitagsfrühstück oder gemeinsames Kochen.
Moderne, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze in top-ausgestatteten Räumlichkeiten.
Home-Office nach individueller Absprache.
Klingt gut? Dann warte nicht länger!
Wenn du Lust hast, in einem digitalen Umfeld Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Teil eines Teams zu werden, das die Zukunft der Steuerberatung aktiv mitgestaltet, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!
Bewirb dich jetzt über das Bewerberformular mit nur wenigen Klicks – schnell, einfach und stressfrei.

ORDERYOYO Senior Software Engineer – Payments Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary About the Role At OrderYOYO , payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Payments to help us build a more resilient, scalable, and compliant payments operating model — across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — across a rapidly growing, international restaurant platform.

Role Mission Own and evolve OrderYOYO 's payments capabilities — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

Core Responsibilities Design, build, and operate payment-domain services, including gateway integrations and payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.
Implement marketplace capabilities where relevant: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.
Build robust “flow-of-funds” primitives — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails — that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.
Integrate with PSP and partner tooling, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.
Implement dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and collaborate with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.
Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.
Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain through automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements — and mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to shared standards and documentation. Payments is too critical to be tribal knowledge.
Must-Have Requirements Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.
Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.
A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.
Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.
Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.
Strong-to-Have Experience Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).
Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.
Who We Are At OrderYOYO , company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build.

Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve. We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business.

By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably. Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe. What We Offer
· Competitive salary. A remote role — work from wherever you do your best work, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

· High ownership and autonomy. Clear progression toward Tech Lead / Staff Engineer responsibilities.
The opportunity to work on revenue-critical production systems.
A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.
A collaborative, international engineering team.
Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and long-term growth.

About Writesonic Every day, millions turn to AI for answers—and if your brand isn't there, you're nowhere.

Writesonic is leading the way with the world's most advanced AI SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform, helping brands monitor and improve visibility across AI search engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

Trusted by marketers worldwide, Writesonic unifies GEO insights with traditional SEO—helping businesses understand how AI sees their brand and giving them the tools to fix it fast. Requirements 🚀 We're Hiring: Full Stack Developer Are you passionate about building fast, scalable, and beautifully crafted products?

Do you thrive in high-ownership roles and love the adrenaline of shipping great features at lightning speed? We're looking for a sharp, motivated Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving real-world problems with code and is excited to build products that scale.

If you're someone with a strong frontend focus, but confident across the full stack—and you care deeply about clean code and great UX—we’d love to chat. 🌟 We’re especially excited to meet folks from Tier 1 engineering colleges (IITs, BITS, IIITs, NITs) or those who have worked at Y Combinator-backed startups.

What You'll Be Doing 🛠 Build and maintain high-performance, user-centric web apps using TypeScript, React/Next.js, and Python. 🤝 Collaborate with design, product, and backend teams to ship features end-to-end. 🎯 Translate UI/UX designs into responsive, pixel-perfect code. 🚀 Optimize applications for speed, performance, and scalability. 🔍 Debug, test, and fix bugs across the stack—ensuring a seamless user experience. 📈 Stay current with the latest in frontend/backend trends, tools, and best practices.

What We're Looking For 1–3 years of professional experience in full stack development (with a strong frontend bias). Solid command of TypeScript and React/Next.js is a must. Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design. Working knowledge of Python and backend logic. Experience integrating RESTful APIs.

Familiar with auth frameworks like JWT. Natural problem-solver with a knack for debugging and optimization. Clear communicator—both in code and in conversation.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us 💰 Competitive salary + performance-based opportunities. 🔁 Potential to earn up to 1.5x your monthly pay as overtime —we believe in rewarding hustle and commitment. ⚙️ Work alongside some of the best engineering minds—learn fast, grow faster. 🚀 We're a team that ships fast, and you'll gain hands-on exposure from day one. 🏝 ** Flexible hours and remote-first culture.** 🎯 High-impact role with complete ownership and autonomy.

We’re a small, fast-moving team that values raw talent, intellectual rigor, and execution speed. We’re building a team of top-tier problem-solvers and creators—if you’re from a Tier 1 CS/ECE program or have worked at a YC-backed company, you’ll feel right at home. Originally posted on Himalayas

We're looking for a Web Developer and Designer who builds code-based websites using AI coding tools as a core part of their workflow. Claude Code is the primary tool in this role.

You will design, build, and ship full websites from concept through launch, combining strong visual design sensibility with the ability to write and ship real code accelerated by AI. This is not a no-code or template-drag role. You build with code, you design with taste, and you use Claude Code to move faster and build better.

If you are a hybrid designer-developer who uses AI to amplify your output rather than replace your judgment, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th) Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy Observance of Holidays per company guidelines 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive Creative freedom to design, build, and ship complete web experiences Work inside an AI-powered marketing platform where your tools and your output are both cutting edge What You'll Work On Design and Concept Development Plan and conceptualize layouts, wireframes, and visual directions aligned with brand strategy and conversion goals Create mockups and component systems in Figma that translate directly into buildable code Maintain a cohesive design language that balances creativity with clarity and performance Code-Based Website Development Build responsive, high-performing websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with Claude Code as your primary development accelerator Use AI coding tools to write, refactor, debug, and ship code faster without sacrificing quality or design integrity Translate Figma designs into production-ready websites that perform well across devices and browsers Collaborate with content and marketing teams to refine UX, user flows, and conversion performance Optimization and Delivery Implement SEO and performance best practices across every project Manage project timelines end to end from creative exploration through launch Test and troubleshoot across devices and browsers to ensure a flawless user experience Continuously find ways to use AI tools to improve speed, output quality, and workflow efficiency What You Bring 3 to 5+ years of experience designing and building full websites with a code-first approach Active daily use of Claude Code or comparable AI coding tools as a primary part of your development workflow Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with the ability to build production-ready sites from scratch Proficiency in Figma for wireframing, component design, and responsive prototyping Strong eye for typography, composition, and conversion-focused design Ability to manage projects independently and meet deadlines without close supervision Clear communication skills and a collaborative mindset Nice to Have Experience with Webflow or Shopify for projects that call for those platforms Familiarity with e-commerce UX and checkout optimization Understanding of SEO principles and site performance optimization Experience creating animations or interactive web components How to Apply Please include: Your updated resume A portfolio link showing two to three full websites you have designed and built A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes ) introducing yourself, walking through a recent project you built using Claude Code or AI coding tools, and explaining how AI fits into your development workflow Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you design with taste, build with code, and use Claude Code to ship faster and better than you could without it, this role gives you the creative freedom and the technical environment to do your best work.

Application Process Overview Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients: Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable) Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step. Originally posted on Himalayas

Experiencia comprobable desarrollando aplicaciones con Ruby on Rails.
Buen manejo de Ruby y del ecosistema Rails.
Experiencia trabajando con bases de datos relacionales, idealmente PostgreSQL y MySQL
Conocimientos de APIs REST, integraciones y procesamiento de datos.
Capacidad para desenvolverse en una aplicación existente, comprender código desarrollado por otras personas y mejorarlo de manera segura.
Experiencia utilizando Git y trabajando con revisiones de código.
Capacidad para investigar problemas a partir de logs, datos y reportes de usuarios.
Disposición para combinar desarrollo de producto con resolución de requerimientos de soporte.
Comunicación clara, autonomía y orientación a la resolución de problemas.
Capacidad para coordinarse con proveedores externos, explicar problemas técnicos con claridad y realizar seguimiento hasta su resolución.
No esperamos que la persona seleccionada domine todas estas tecnologías. Nos interesa especialmente una base sólida en desarrollo con Rails, capacidad para resolver problemas reales y motivación por aprender y aplicar automatización e inteligencia artificial.
Buscamos un/a Software Engineer con experiencia en Ruby on Rails para incorporarse a nuestro equipo y participar en el desarrollo, mantenimiento y soporte de nuestras plataformas.
El foco principal del cargo será trabajar directamente sobre aplicaciones Rails: desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades, resolver problemas técnicos, mejorar sistemas existentes y apoyar la continuidad operacional.Además, queremos que esta persona nos ayude a incorporar progresivamente automatizaciones y herramientas de inteligencia artificial que permitan simplificar procesos, reducir tareas manuales y mejorar la atención de requerimientos.
Es un cargo práctico y técnico, ideal para alguien que disfrute entender sistemas existentes, investigar problemas y convertir necesidades operacionales en soluciones de software confiables.
Principales Responsabilidades
Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web construidas con Ruby on Rails.
Implementar nuevas funcionalidades, integraciones y mejoras técnicas.
Diagnosticar y resolver errores o preguntas reportados por usuarios.
Investigar incidentes, identificar su causa y proponer soluciones permanentes.
Construir automatizaciones para reducir tareas manuales y repetitivas.
Integrar APIs y servicios de terceros.
Explorar e implementar usos concretos de inteligencia artificial, como clasificación de solicitudes, extracción de información, asistentes internos o generación de respuestas.
Mantener documentación técnica y compartir conocimiento con el equipo.
Participar en reuniones de levantamiento de requerimientos para nuevas funcionalidades con otras áreas.
Mantener una relación técnica y operativa con proveedores externos responsables de algunas integraciones.
Levantar, documentar y dar seguimiento a problemas relacionados con integraciones administradas por terceros, entregando antecedentes técnicos claros y coordinando su resolución.
Verificar las soluciones entregadas por los proveedores y mantener informados a los equipos internos sobre su avance.
Experiencia con procesamiento de tareas en segundo plano, por ejemplo Delayed Jobs/Good Job.
Experiencia desarrollando con Vibe Codign.
Experiencia utilizando herramientas de automatización como n8n, Make o Zapier.
Haber integrado modelos de lenguaje mediante APIs de OpenAI, Anthropic, Google u otros proveedores.
Experiencia previa en plataformas SaaS o sistemas con usuarios en producción, experiencia utilizando algún ERP como SAP B1.
Interés por comprender procesos de negocio y transformarlos en soluciones técnicas.
En Grupo Amoblé creemos que la gente hace buen trabajo cuando está bien. Por eso, más allá del sueldo, te ofrecemos un entorno donde tu trabajo se nota, tu criterio se respeta y tienes espacio real para crecer:
Contrato indefinido (planta).
Modalidad híbrida en Santiago.
Ownership real sobre las integraciones y automatizaciones del grupo, con espacio para proponer y decidir.
Stack moderno y foco genuino en IA aplicada al negocio (no solo discurso).
Empresa B Certificada, con compromiso real de equidad salarial y desarrollo de las personas.
Descuentos en nuestras marcas de muebles y decoración.

Formación Académica
Ingeniería Civil en Computación / Informática, Ingeniería en Computación e Informática o similar.
Experiencia Profesional
3 a 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo Full Stack con fuerte foco en Backend.
Conocimientos Específicos
Node.js y Vue.js
Bases de datos SQL y conocimientos en bases de datos NoSQL.
Experiencia práctica en la nube
Experiencia demostrable o alta familiaridad utilizando herramientas de IA para agilizar el desarrollo de software.
1 Migración Tecnológica: Participar activamente en la migración de sistemas legacy (Llama) hacia tecnologías modernas como Node.js (backend) y Vue.js (frontend).
2 Eficiencia con IA: Integrar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) en tu flujo de desarrollo diario para optimizar tiempos y calidad de código.
3 Mentoría y Colaboración: Apoyar en la formación técnica de los miembros más junior del equipo (practicante y trainee), colaborando codo a codo con el desarrollador Senior y el líder de la célula.
4 Desarrollo Full Stack: Escribir código limpio, mantenible y escalable, con foco prioritario en la lógica de negocio del Backend, sin descuidar la integración con el Frontend.
5 Migración y Gestión Cloud: Diseñar y ejecutar la migración de bases de datos SQL locales hacia la nube, utilizando Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service).
Presencial inicialmente: Lunes a Jueves 09:00 a 18:30 y Viernes 09:00 a 17:00 hrs.

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickeln wir bei SEPPmail wegweisende Secure-E-Mail-Lösungen, die Inhalte und Absenderidentität zuverlässig schützen und Spam oder Malware zuverlässig in ihre Schranken weisen – ohne technische Hürden für Absender oder Empfänger, flexibel integrierbar und immer mit höchstem Anspruch an Sicherheit und Vertraulichkeit. Über 3.400 Endkunden aus Branchen wie Medizin, Energie, Finanz- und Versicherungswesen, öffentlicher Verwaltung, Pharma und Recht vertrauen auf unsere Technologie, um ihre E-Mail-Kommunikation sicher zu gestalten.
Mit Sitz in der Schweiz und Deutschland verbinden wir die Präzision und Verlässlichkeit eines Schweizer Taschenmessers mit deutscher Gründlichkeit. Unsere zentralen Werte – Offenheit, Zuverlässigkeit, Wertschätzung und Kompetenz – prägen die Zusammenarbeit im Team genauso wie den Umgang mit unseren Kunden und Partnern.
SEPPmail ist Teil von LEA Partners, einem auf Softwareunternehmen spezialisierten PE-Unternehmen. LEA Partners stellt ein ausgezeichnetes Netzwerk an Branchen-/Industrie-Experten zur Verfügung und leistet so einen erheblichen Mehrwert für die persönliche und unternehmerische Weiterentwicklung.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir eine erfahrene, generalistisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die mit Leidenschaft für sauberen Code und moderne Entwicklungsmethoden unsere Produkte weiterentwickelt.
Diese Stelle ist vollständig im Homeoffice zu besetzen - Du kannst von überall in Deutschland oder der Schweiz aus arbeiten.
Aufgaben
Du entwickelst als Full-Stack-Entwickler mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf dem Backend an unseren Produkten und Lösungen mit
Du konzipierst und implementierst robuste Backend-Services und arbeitest dort, wo nötig, auch am Frontend mit
Du gestaltest Datenbankschemen mit und bringst dein Verständnis von CI/CD-Prozessen in unsere Entwicklungspipelines ein
Du setzt KI-gestützte, agentische Entwicklungsmethoden gezielt und verantwortungsvoll ein, um Entwicklungsprozesse zu beschleunigen – stets mit Fokus auf sauberen, wartbaren und getesteten Code

Du möchtest nicht nur bestehende Software weiterentwickeln, sondern aus realen industriellen Herausforderungen neue technische Lösungen entstehen lassen? Du verbindest sehr gute Python- und Backend-Kenntnisse mit Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Data Science und künstlicher Intelligenz?
Dann entwickle mit uns datenbasierte Anwendungen, Prototypen und Demonstratoren – gemeinsam mit Industrieunternehmen, Technologiepartnern, Start-ups und Forschungseinrichtungen.
Über den Smart Systems Hub
Der Smart Systems Hub in Dresden ist ein Innovationszentrum für die digitale und vernetzte Industrie. Wir bringen unterschiedliche technologische und fachliche Kompetenzen zusammen, um aus Ideen praktisch erprobbare Lösungen zu entwickeln.
In Co-Innovationsprojekten, Design Sprints, Hackathons und Rapid-Prototyping-Formaten arbeiten wir an konkreten Herausforderungen aus Produktion und Industrie. Dabei verbinden wir Softwareentwicklung, Daten, künstliche Intelligenz, Sensorik, Hardware und Cloud-Technologien zu funktionierenden Gesamtlösungen.
Aufgaben
Deine Rolle
Als Python Software Engineer entwickelst du die technische Grundlage unserer datenbasierten und KI-gestützten Lösungen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Python, Backend-Entwicklung, Data Engineering und Data Science.
Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten technischen Einordnung über die Architektur und Implementierung bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototyp. Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einem dauerhaft festgelegten Produktkontext, sondern an wechselnden industriellen Fragestellungen mit unterschiedlichen Partnern, Datenquellen und technischen Rahmenbedingungen.
Du bewertest, was technisch machbar und sinnvoll ist, triffst pragmatische Architekturentscheidungen und sorgst dafür, dass auch schnell entwickelte Lösungen auf einer professionellen Softwarebasis stehen.
Deine Aufgaben
Du entwickelst modulare und wartbare Backend-Anwendungen, APIs, Datenservices und Integrationskomponenten mit Python.
Du konzipierst cloudbasierte Software- und Datenarchitekturen und verbindest Backend-, Daten-, KI-, Edge- und Cloud-Komponenten zu funktionierenden Gesamtsystemen.
Du entwickelst robuste Datenpipelines sowie ETL- und ELT-Prozesse für Maschinen-, Sensor-, Bild-, Ereignis- und Zeitreihendaten.
Du integrierst geeignete Cloud-Services, Datenbanken, Speicher- und Streaming-Technologien und stellst Datenqualität, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Verfügbarkeit sicher.
Du analysierst Daten, entwickelst geeignete Merkmale und setzt Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Ansätze prototypisch um.
Du bewertest Datenqualität, Modellgüte, technische Machbarkeit und die Grenzen datenbasierter Lösungsansätze.
Du entwickelst und integrierst Computer-Vision-Lösungen, beispielsweise für visuelle Qualitätskontrolle, Condition Monitoring oder Predictive Maintenance.
Du gestaltest Hardware-Software-Architekturen mit, in denen Kameras, Sensorik, Edge-Systeme, Datenpipelines, Cloud-Komponenten und KI-Modelle zusammenspielen.
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern in Design Sprints, Hackathons und Co-Innovationsprojekten funktionsfähige Prototypen und Demonstratoren.
Du sicherst die Qualität deiner Lösungen durch strukturiertes API-Design, automatisierte Tests, Code Reviews, Versionsverwaltung, Containerisierung, CI/CD und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation.

Sehr gute und in Projekten nachgewiesene Python-Kenntnisse sowie belastbare Erfahrung in der professionellen Backend- oder Softwareentwicklung.
Fundierte Kenntnisse im Data Engineering und praktische Erfahrung mit Datenpipelines, Datenintegration sowie ETL- oder ELT-Prozessen.

Projekterfahrung mit Computer Vision, Bildverarbeitung oder vergleichbaren Machine-Learning-Anwendungen.

Erfahrung mit Cloud-Architekturen und Cloud-Services, idealerweise im AWS-Umfeld.

Senior Software Engineer, Semantic Data Team
WEX is reimagining its enterprise data platform with a powerful goal: transforming raw data into semantically meaningful, reusable, and trusted business assets. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Semantic Data Team, you'll contribute to designing, building, and maintaining control plane for Semantic layer and AI Native data platforms supporting our core 360 data objects (Customer, Fleet, Health and Payments)
An embedded DataOps backbone and self-service control plane ensures governance, lineage, observability, and operational efficiency at scale. Together, these elements empower WEX to modernize responsibly—continuously delivering business value while evolving toward a future where intelligence and automation are built on a foundation of governed, high-quality data.
This team is at the heart of WEX's DaaS platform where the platform integrates DataOps automation, control plane services, and governance tooling to uphold quality and trust at scale, enabling trusted, production-grade semantic models through automated controls, audit validation, and operational alignment.
Wex is highly invested in building AI native data platform. The Agentic Control Plane is the runtime layer that determines how an AI agent interprets a user request, assembles the right context, applies the right rules and constraints, uses approved tools, and drives the next step.
We're looking for an AI-native engineer: someone who builds with modern AI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and similar) and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as a core part of their daily workflow. You'll use these tools to accelerate development and apply solid engineering judgment to ship production-grade, trustworthy data assets.
How you'll make an impact
Engineer the Operational Backbone: You will design and implement the core infrastructure of the Control Plane, serving as the central execution engine that orchestrates the entire data lifecycle—from ingestion and transformation to final distribution.
Shift from Reactive to Proactive: You will transform platform reliability by building sophisticated observability frameworks and automated quality gates, ensuring that data trust is engineered into the system rather than inspected after the fact.
Drive Self-Service Autonomy: You will eliminate operational bottlenecks by developing intuitive portals and "golden templates," empowering domain teams to autonomously build, manage, and consume trusted data products.
Champion Platform Governance: You will automate critical compliance and security policies, including end-to-end data lineage, role-based access control (RBAC), and PII protection, making security an inherent feature of our data objects.
Prepare for AI-Native Scale: You will build the foundational data architecture required for our AI future, contributing to the development of the context and RAG-based systems that will power the next generation of data-driven intelligence.
Leverage AI coding assistants (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and similar) to accelerate development—drafting transformation logic, generating tests, refactoring pipelines, exploring datasets, and producing semantic documentation—while critically reviewing AI output for correctness and alignment with business rules.
Share patterns, prompts, and workflows that help the team get more leverage out of AI tooling, contributing to AI-native engineering practices across the Semantic Data Team.
Work closely with domain experts, data scientists, and product stakeholders to translate business concepts into framework that supports development
Implement logic for classifications, KPIs, scoring algorithms, and business rules, ensuring traceability and data lineage.
Follow and contribute to standards for data modeling, documentation, and governance within the semantic layer—including responsible, auditable use of AI-generated code and artifacts.
Collaborate across teams to integrate with ingestion, MDM, and data product layers.
Experience you'll bring
4–8 years of experience in data engineering or software engineering with a focus on data transformation, modeling, or analytics platforms.
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose language such as Python or Scala.
Demonstrated experience as an AI-native engineer—using tools like Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar as a regular part of your development workflow.
AI-Native Architecture: You are passionate about the future of data intelligence and have hands-on experience with LLM-driven architectures. You are comfortable designing RAG systems, building agentic workflows (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI), and working with vector/graph databases to manage context and ontology.
Familiarity with modern AI engineering practices such as prompt design, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and AI-assisted code review.
Advanced Data Orchestration & Pipeline Reliability: You possess deep expertise in building and managing complex orchestration systems (specifically Airflow) and are obsessed with reliability. You know how to engineer "quality-first" pipelines using frameworks like Great Expectations to ensure data trust at scale.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Platform Engineering: You are fluent in the modern DevOps stack—including Terraform, Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation—allowing you to build self-healing, scalable infrastructure that minimizes operational toil.
Enterprise Governance & Metadata Management: You have a proven track record of implementing automated governance, specifically utilizing DataHub or similar platforms to manage end-to-end lineage, cataloging, and RBAC policies that make security inherent to the data object.
Observability & Incident Management: You understand that "the platform is the product." You bring experience building comprehensive observability frameworks (e.g., Grafana, xMatters integration) that move teams from reactive firefighting to proactive, automated alerting.
Self-Service Mindset: You advocate for "developer autonomy" over manual intervention. You have experience building intuitive portals and developer tools that enable domain teams to build, manage, and consume trusted data products independently.
Solid understanding of data quality practices—including validation, enrichment, schema enforcement, and business rule encoding.
Comfort operating in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, balancing business logic with platform scalability.
A proven track record for traceability, reproducibility, and semantic clarity—you build data models others can trust and reuse.

Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. Businesses worldwide send over $20 trillion annually in rewards, remittances, and disbursements often incurring costs of up to 50% per transaction and subjecting recipients to lengthy delays.
Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. The Runa API empowers thousands of businesses to make payments to 5 billion+ consumers in 190+ countries instantly to cards, wallets, bank accounts and gift cards.

Leading companies such as Sodexo, TopCashback, Perkbox, Sweatcoin, Coinbase, and Globetopper rely on Runa to facilitate instant, flexible global payouts to tens of millions of consumers.

Propelus ® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.
As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.

Immuware's customers, including Employee Health nurses; occupational health managers; and compliance professionals, work in one of the most requirement-heavy environments in healthcare IT. Regulations shift. Organizational structures change. New workflows emerge. Each of these changes often means hands-on work is needed inside their Immuware environment.
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) exists to meet that need. It's a technical role embedded in the post-sales customer experience. It is not account management, not billable project work, and not break-fix support. The FDE shows up on customer calls, understands exactly what a health-system nurse manager is trying to accomplish, and gets it done.

This is a process that happens through configuration, scripting, integrations, or code, and by partnering with product and engineering when the problem is bigger than one person.
The FDE owns the technical depth: live solutioning, hands-on building, and the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams.

As our Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will own the technical resolution of customer problems end to end, from understanding the need, building the fix, landing it with product and engineering when it's bigger than you, to ultimately serve as the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams. You're measured on customer outcomes, not on activity.
This role partners closely with our Customer Success Managers, who own the overall customer relationship, strategy, and commercial outcomes.
Technical Solutioning & Building
Lead regular (often weekly) technical working sessions with customers to address actively evolving needs driven by regulatory changes, organizational shifts, and workflow updates.
Configure, script, and-where it's the right tool-write code to solve customer needs: workflow setup, rule-building, field configuration, user and role management, reporting, data corrections, integrations, and small platform changes.
Translate complex Employee Health requirements (OSHA compliance, state-specific immunization mandates, system credentialing workflows, and the like) into solutions that actually work for our clients, in the Immuware platform (open to suggestions!) .
Question the requirements: Challenge requests that don't serve the customer's real goal, and choose the simplest solution that solves the underlying problem.
Thoroughly document your solution designs in Notion, while updating live items in Jira, to ensure they are repeatable and transferable.
Generalize your work. Turn one-off fixes into reusable templates, decision trees, or product improvements so the next customer benefits.
Triage net-new module or record-type additions that need a formal Letter of Work (LOW) and/or an ARR change (expansion) to CSMs and Professional Services.
Customer Partnership
Serve as the technical counterpart to CSMs on customer calls. CSMs handle the relationship; you handle "how do we make it work."
Working alongside the CSMs, lead deeper, in-depth customer education beyond basic platform navigation, run workflow specific walkthroughs, and re-train as staff turnover and organizational change creates knowledge gaps.
Build trusted-advisor relationships with power users and technical contacts at customer organizations.
Spot configuration gaps or risks before they turn into escalations.
Stay aware of each assigned customer's environment, history, and upcoming needs.
Product & Engineering Collaboration
Partner directly with product and engineering: open pull requests, pair on fixes, and reproduce or root-cause issues in the codebase where you can.
Monitoring surface patterns across customers: repeated requests, regulatory gaps, and workflow limitations, and bring them to Product with specificity and customer context.
Contribute to the internal knowledge base: common configurations, decision trees, scripts, and workarounds, so the team scales.
Support Bridge & Scoping
Fix what you can, and hand off a clean, dev-ready ticket for what you can't. Identify potential bugs or system issues, partner with development to solve for the root cause, and reproduce solutions at scale.
Write clear, well-scoped bug reports and feature requests that enable engineering to act without back-and-forth.
Confidently identify and navigate between "I can fix this," "this needs a support ticket," and "this needs a product change."
What This Role Is Not
Not account ownership. CSMs own renewals, expansion, and the executive relationship. The FDE supports those relationships through technical excellence.
Not billable Professional Services. PS handles formal implementation projects with SOWs. The FDE handles ongoing, post-go-live technical needs as part of the customer's subscription.
Not the L1/L2 support queue. The support team owns routine bug triage. This FDE will do deeper scoping and fixes, ensuring a clean handoff. It does not replace the support workflow.
You'll Thrive in This Role If You
Are energized by customer calls and like solving problems live, not async.
Can read a healthcare compliance requirement and immediately start thinking about how to model and build it in a SaaS platform.
Have a builder's mindset: you're systematic, you test your own work, you write code when it's the right tool, and you don't leave a solution half-done.
Can switch comfortably between explaining something to an IT admin, a head nurse, a customer executive, and your own engineering team.
Are naturally organized. You manage several customers with different environments and needs at once.
Get frustrated by workarounds and push internally for real solutions.

5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation consultant, technical account manager, or forward deployed engineer) handling client resolutions, both live (virtually) and post meeting action items, and know how to navigate delays while staying calm under pressure and maintaining the clients trust.
4-5 years navigating Azure, JavaScript, and Typescript with a strong background in SQL and Azure SQL database management.

Proficiency in C#, and comfort reading a codebase, debugging, and writing scripts or small features. track record of building on SaaS platforms, not just toggling settings: creating non-trivial workflows, rules, forms, reports, integrations, or role and permission structures.

About Vulcury
Vulcury is a venture studio building a portfolio of companies anchored by proprietary AI and data infrastructure. Our two lead ventures are Trustbridge, a manufacturing and supply chain matchmaking platform, and Calisade, an investment research and asset management venture with a strong performance track record. We are backed by a committed lead investor and operate with a small, deliberately senior team.

We are hiring a founding engineer to lead the technical build of our first production product — a Trustbridge supplier matching application — and to grow into a senior technical anchor across the studio over time. This is a full-time, permanent role, not a contract or a project hire. We are looking for someone who wants a long-horizon seat at a company in formation.
You will report to the founder, with technical oversight and architecture support from our Fractional CTO (background in major financial technology). You will lead and grow our existing team of junior engineers and interns based in India.
What You Will Work On
In the near term, your work centers on the Trustbridge supplier app: model selection, agent and matching logic, the data and inference layer, the API surface, and the production infrastructure that gets it in front of real users. The product is a discovery instrument — real supplier usage will tell us what to build next, and you will be the person turning that signal into the next iteration.
Over a longer horizon, the work expands. The studio is building a cross-portfolio data and AI infrastructure that connects Trustbridge, Calisade, and future ventures. As the wedge product matures, you will help shape that infrastructure and take on technical leadership of work in adjacent domains — applied ML on the Calisade side, the cross-portfolio semantic layer, and external client engagements in our AI implementation practice.
We are not hiring for a fixed scope. We are hiring someone we expect to redeploy across multiple problem areas as the portfolio grows.

7–12 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful depth in applied ML, AI systems, or modern data infrastructure. We are not looking for a specialist in any single sub-discipline — we are looking for a senior generalist with real production chops.
You have shipped a production system end-to-end. Not a prototype, not a research artifact. You can talk concretely about what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently.
You are comfortable across the stack you would touch in this role: model and agent design, data modeling and pipelines, backend services, and the production infrastructure that holds it all together. You do not need to be the world expert in all of these. You do need to be competent across most of them and have a clear opinion about where your center of gravity sits.
You have led junior engineers before. You know how to set a technical bar without micromanaging, and you know how to grow people.
You write clearly — code, design docs, decisions, and the occasional message to a non-technical founder who needs to understand the tradeoffs.
You are comfortable with ambiguity. Requirements will evolve as real users start using what you build, and you need to find that energizing rather than frustrating.
You want to build something that lasts. You are looking for a long-horizon seat at a company in formation, not a resume line.

Location and Working Style
Remote, based in India — preference for Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, or Chennai for occasional in-person collaboration. We work with a 3–4 hour daily overlap window with US Pacific time, primarily for design reviews and founder syncs. The rest of the day is yours for focused build work.
